name: Rythu Bandhu
eligibility_summary: All farmer land owners in Telangana with pattadar passbook. No income ceiling.

name: Rythu Bima
eligibility_summary: Farmer pattadars in Telangana aged 18-59 years.

name: Telangana ePASS Scholarship
eligibility_summary: SC/ST/BC/EBC/Minority students from Telangana. Family income below ₹2 lakh.

name: Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak
eligibility_summary: Woman aged 18+ from Telangana belonging to SC/ST/BC/Minority/EBC. Family income below ₹2 lakh.

name: Aasara Pension Scheme
eligibility_summary: Telangana resident meeting category-specific criteria: 65+ for old age pension, widows, PwD (40%+), etc.

name: Dalit Bandhu
eligibility_summary: Scheduled Caste (Dalit) families in Telangana, selected constituency-wise.

name: T-Hub Startup Incubation
eligibility_summary: Registered startup/entrepreneur. Preferably based in Hyderabad/Telangana.

name: WE Hub — Women Entrepreneurship
eligibility_summary: Women entrepreneurs and women-led startups. Preferably from Telangana.

name: Telangana Skill Development Programme
eligibility_summary: Youth aged 15-35 from Telangana. No minimum education for many courses.

name: CM Overseas Scholarship for BC/EBC/Minorities
eligibility_summary: BC/EBC/Minority student from Telangana. Family income below ₹5 lakh. Admission in foreign university.
